Room.title: Parcheesi Voice Room
Room.description: Real-time multiplayer room state, host-controlled Parcheesi launch state, and audio-only WebRTC SDP signaling.

hostName.description: Display name of the host player who created the room.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player once joined (empty string while waiting).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the room: waiting -> connected (Room Menu) -> playing (Parcheesi) -> closed.

activeGame.description: Host-controlled active game. Strictly null in the Room Menu; set to 'parcheesi' only when Host launches Parcheesi.

scores.description: Map of Parcheesi victory counters for the current room session.

diceCount.description: Selected Parcheesi dice count (1 or 2), controlled by the host and synced live.

offer.description: Latest audio-only WebRTC SDP offer created by the host (or null before negotiation).

answer.description: Latest audio-only WebRTC SDP answer created by the guest (or null before negotiation).

webrtcGen.description: Monotonic WebRTC signaling generation counter for renegotiation and ICE restarts.

hostHasAudio.description: Whether the host currently has an active microphone audio stream.

guestHasAudio.description: Whether the guest currently has an active microphone audio stream.

hostMicMuted.description: Whether the host microphone is currently muted.

guestMicMuted.description: Whether the guest microphone is currently muted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

RoomChatMessage.title: Room Live Chat Message
RoomChatMessage.description: Persistent live text message or quick emoji reaction sent inside a room across Room Menu and Parcheesi.

sender.description: Role of the player who sent the chat message.

text.description: Chat message text or quick reaction emoji.

kind.description: Whether this item is a standard text chat message or a quick reaction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat message was created.

RoomMessage.title: Room Parcheesi Event
RoomMessage.description: Authoritative Parcheesi move, dice roll, board state sync, or quick taunt event inside a room.

sender.description: Role of the player who emitted the game event.

payload.description: Structured Parcheesi event payload containing a valid type field.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was persisted.

IceCandidate.title: Audio WebRTC ICE Candidate
IceCandidate.description: Trickle ICE candidate exchanged between host and guest for audio-only RTCPeerConnection.

sender.description: Role of the peer that gathered this ICE candidate.

webrtcGen.description: Negotiation generation associated with this ICE candidate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the candidate was added.

/rooms/{code}.description: Active 2-player Parcheesi voice rooms indexed by normalized 4-character uppercase alphanumeric code.

/rooms/{code}/chat/{chatId}.description: Append-only live chat messages and quick reactions persisted across Room Menu and Parcheesi.

/rooms/{code}/messages/{messageId}.description: Append-only real-time Parcheesi game events, moves, dice rolls, and board states for a room.

/rooms/{code}/candidates/{candidateId}.description: Append-only audio-only WebRTC trickle ICE candidates exchanged between host and guest.
